Officer's narrative
Driver 1 reported that a vehicle in the adjacent lane drifted into their lane while changing lanes in Katy, Texas,
causing a sideswipe collision. Driver 1 was operating a sedan with a Passenger seated in the front passenger seat at
the time of the impact. Driver 1 stated that they experienced lower back strain immediately after the collision and was
assessed at the scene. The reported injury is consistent with the type and force of a lateral impact of this nature.
Physical damage to the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle is consistent with the described impact. Photographs taken
at the scene confirm several of the reported details, although a few older scratches elsewhere on the vehicle may
predate this incident and were noted for reference only. No independent witnesses were identified. Responding
officers and other persons on scene confirmed that Driver 1 and the Passenger were both inside the vehicle at the
time of the collision. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the policy in force at the time of the incident. The second
vehicle's operator, Driver 2, was issued a citation for fialure to maintain a single lane.
